en: Fixed logs and transcripts showing part of a URL password that contains punctuation such as `)`, quotes, `]`, `&` or a second `@`, or that runs past a `/` to a bracketed host such as `[::1]` in an ssh URL
zh: 修复了日志和转录显示部分 URL 密码的问题，这些密码包含 `)`、引号、`]`、`&` 或第二个 `@` 等标点，或在 ssh URL 中越过 `/` 延伸到 `[::1]` 这类带方括号的主机
